reviews.comment: Lectures were unorganized but still helpful. 90% of the grade is quizzes and exams, and there is almost no study material or indication what the quiz will be on until it starts. Will randomly start talking about branch prediction. Overall not a bad professor, but not my top choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I generally didn't treat this class as a real course, but it's not hard to get an A. There's no posted study materials, so be sure to take good notes and show up to class, there's no lectures uploaded. He's a boring lecturer and yaps a lot but you need to pay attention. Final is cumulative but questions were taken from previous exams that semester.

Passionate about what he does and the topic of the class. Uses generic slides that are posted and can be a bit boring to sit and listen to. Grades are mostly exams with some quizzes, which are made by the  TA. Dropped 1 homework, quiz, and exam at the end, including the final. Exams weren't too difficult, but not a breeze either.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Jimenez is amazing in the field, but he rambles, is reluctant to work with school conflicts, and is transparent about not being very available. Aside from that, there's only slides with often no online supplementary material. Tests are also extremely punishing if you are behind at all. TA does a lot of heavy lifting.
Prof is a genius but the class is hard

Jimenez is a pretty chill guy and he enjoys what he teaches. He doesn't assign much work (only 6 homework & 4 quizzes). The exams were most of our grade, but if you studied you should be fine. His lectures were a little hard for me to sit through, but the slides were insightful and the assignments were fun.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: TA is make or break. Had a great one and crushed the quizzes with lots of EC. Dr. Jimenez's lectures can drag, but he is knowledgeable and available for questions. This semester's tests were incredibly easy, but be careful because he keeps talking about making it harder. Downside. He's unpersonable. Never says howdy, quiet, doesn't smile.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good computer architecture class because of the two projects. Do the project on your own, you will learn a lot. Coming to the classes, lectures are okish, but fun sometimes. Heavy homeworks for a very little credit.
Teaches well. Has a good sense of humor, most of the times. Projects are important, and they are fun. Tests aren't terribly difficult.
